name: hexaemeron
description: One-shot delivery loop: study, runbook, then per-step issue/implement/audit/prose/push to a working prototype, receipt-backed and resumable.

interface.shortDescription: One-shot delivery loop with receipts: study, runbook, issue, build, audit, prose, push.
interface.longDescription: Takes a topic from nothing to a working prototype through a receipt-backed controller: a linted study, a runbook of discrete steps, then per step an issue, the simplest satisfying implementation, a security loop over the vendored Pashov suite (x-ray, solidity-auditor, fizz) until clean or reasoned out, a prose pass through the bundled imprimatur and vulgate masks, and a pushed PR. State survives resets in a hash-chained ledger; resume is the same command.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $hexaemeron to take "<topic>" from study to a pushed prototype, one receipted phase at a time.
